title: Surreal Cheerleader Ritual
description: Three pale, nude, hairless humanoid figures with white masks perform a synchronized dance while holding bright pink pom-poms in a dilapidated artist's studio. The chaotic room features splattered paint on the walls, torn classical paintings, broken furniture, scattered red petals, and dramatic theatrical lighting from above.
prompt: Three pale, hairless, nude humanoid figures wearing smooth white masks dance dynamically in a destroyed painter's studio, vigorously waving bright pink pom-poms that leave motion trails. The room has paint-splattered walls, torn classical paintings in ornate frames, broken easels, red rose petals and feathers scattered across the floor, dramatic spotlight from above cutting through dusty air, dark curtains, surreal and unsettling atmosphere, highly detailed cinematic lighting
